name: cospotech-ecommerce
description: Cospotech — Consecrated Spiritual Artefacts & Luxury E-Commerce Platform

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('prisma')) fs.mkdirSync('prisma'); if(fs.existsSync('backend/prisma/dev.db') && !fs.existsSync('prisma/dev.db')) fs.copyFileSync('backend/prisma/dev.db', 'prisma/dev.db');" && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build
